{{Quote|The reason for the war was plasma, and the Houses that contributed most to funding the mercenary army were House Tapalo and House Veruna. When my grandfather learned of this he challenged Tapalo's father to a duel of honor, and eventually succumbed to the injuries Tapalo's blade inflicted.|[[Cosinga Palpatine]]|<ref name="Darth Plagueis (novel)">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
'''House Tapalo''' was a [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] family that resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. According to [[Cosinga Palpatine]], in about [[135 BBY/Legends|135 BBY]], Houses Tapalo, [[House Veruna|Veruna]] and others hired a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to attack Naboo's native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], as part of a ploy to gain access to Naboo's [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] resources. However, [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]] learned of their plot and a [[Cosinga Palpatine's grandfather|member]] of the House challenged a [[Tapalo|member]] of House Tapalo to an honor duel; Tapalo won. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]] of House Tapalo was elected as Naboo's [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]].
